title: Construct Context Envelope v1
description: The state handed between `construct pipeline run` steps (and, more broadly, between any two Construct generator commands run with --json) so an LLM or script driving a multi-step build never has to re-derive what already exists -- it reads the envelope from the previous step's stdout and passes it straight to the next. See src/engine/envelope.mjs (createEnvelope/validateEnvelope) and src/engine/pipeline.mjs for the runtime shapes this describes; docs/README should point back here as the source of truth.

version.description: Envelope schema version. Bump this file to v2 (envelope.v2.json) on any breaking shape change rather than mutating v1 in place.

feature.description: The Construct feature name (features/<feature>/...) this envelope tracks.

status.description: 'pending' on the way in (a request envelope); 'committed' or 'aborted' on the way out of a pipeline step, depending on whether construct validate passed on the buffered result.

layers.description: Map of layer name (domain/service/workflow/hook/page/component/controller/route) to the project-relative file paths that layer owns for this feature so far. Populated incrementally as pipeline steps commit.

unboundSlots.description: Interactive props/callbacks discovered on an ingested pristine page (Ticket 7.2) that have no wired handler yet -- consumed by the controller binder (Ticket 7.4) to know what it still needs to wire up.

kind.description: 'callback' for an event handler prop (onClick, onChange, ...), 'value' for a bound value prop (value, checked, ...).

component.description: The exported component name the slot was found on, e.g. CheckoutPage.

events.description: XState event types exposed by this feature's workflow (Ticket 7.3), for downstream consumers such as the controller binder (Ticket 7.4).

payload.description: Map of payload field name to its TS type as a string, e.g. { "value": "string" }.

diagnostics.description: construct validate violations (diagnostics.mjs's makeViolation shape) produced by the last validation attempt on this envelope's buffered result. Empty when status is 'committed'.

steps.description: Input-only: the generation steps for `construct pipeline run` to execute against this envelope in order (e.g. [{layer:'domain',name:'Total'},{layer:'service',name:'Total'}]). Always empty/absent on an envelope emitted as output -- a completed step's result is reflected in `layers` instead.

layer.description: One of the architecture layers, e.g. domain/service/workflow/hook/page/component/controller.

name.description: The unit's base name, e.g. "Total" for a TotalService/useTotal/etc.
